perimeter: Every vendor-payment line in the Controller's voucher file from FY2018 on, grouped by the City's own sub-object accounting code. FY2018 is the floor because the chart of accounts was renumbered that year: the same concept carries a different code before and after, so a series across the break would silently split.

class_definitions.purchase: Goods and services bought from outside the City.
class_definitions.obligation: Money out that is not a purchase: debt service, employee benefit plans, tax withholding, payments to other governments.
class_definitions.ledger: Balance-sheet and revenue lines that appear in the payments file without being a payment for anything.
class_definitions.unclear: Not confidently classified; shown folded, never as fact.

classification_note: The class is a display classification of the City's sub-object codes, not a figure from the source. Every dollar comes from the vouchers; only the grouping is ours.
exemplar_note: The example on each row is the largest single vendor x department line in that category and year, excluding related government units so a category is never illustrated by an internal transfer. Totals still include every line.
